label: Self-check
actions: Re-measure any reading that looks off, following the measurement tip.
Follow the guidance for your systems.

label: Log and monitor
actions: Record the reading and note how you feel.
Tell the crew medical officer if one is on board.

label: Contact flight surgeon
actions: Send a non-urgent request to the flight surgeon with the generated report.
Repeat the measurement first and note the time.
Follow mission medical procedures while you wait.

label: Urgent
actions: Follow the mission emergency medical procedure.
The report is sent first as soon as the link allows.
